name: TrueNAS
description: Reads a TrueNAS (Community Edition 25.04 or newer) and shows it as a host with what runs on it: containers and virtual machines (matched to the devices on your network by IP or MAC address) and apps. Also reports the Storage page (needs Netlens 0.4.180): pools with their fill level and health, their disks, NFS and SMB shares and open alerts. Read-only: one login with an API key, a few reads, then it disconnects.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Also fills the Storage page (pools, volumes, disks, shares). Needs Netlens 0.4.180 or newer.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
Adds a dashboard card with running and stopped apps, containers and virtual machines. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
Several TrueNAS systems can be read: one line per system with its own address and API key, a Test button per line, and Test all. Existing settings carry over. Needs Netlens 0.3.109 or newer.

Guests now carry details: CPU and memory of VMs and containers, and for apps the version, whether an update is available, the image and the ports they publish (the host's Open ports table names the app). Needs Netlens 0.2.106 or newer.
First release. Containers, VMs and apps of a TrueNAS as guests of the NAS.
Adds a diagnostic report: a Run diagnostic button on the plugin's page (Netlens 0.2.67 or newer) shows an anonymised description of what TrueNAS answers, to copy or download.
